content:
noa_peopleops: quick all-hands follow-up: consolidating a few manager Qs about promos/comp that came up. dropping short answers and a tiny packet checklist so folks can copy/paste.
evan_total_rewards: will add a couple notes about global comp and currency conversions.
sophia_ceo: appreciate a concise FAQ managers can share in 1:1s.
omar_mgr: two manager asks: 1) what happens to promos during employee relocation (geo pay change)? 2) how to handle public announcement consent?
li_eng: also saw a question about deferred promos if an external offer falls through shortly after promotion.

noa_peopleops: 1) relocation/geo adjustments
- principle: base pay is set by band + local market adjustment. if a promo coincides with a move, we apply the market adjustment for the employee's home location effective on the promotion date. communicate the delta clearly.
- if a move is planned but not effective by the promo date, use current location unless parties agree otherwise.

noa_peopleops: 2) public announcement & privacy
- default: treat promotions as internal news. managers should ask the employee if they'd like a public announcement (Slack/company update). respect privacy requests and delay public posts until employee agrees.

noa_peopleops: 3) offer rescind / promo rollback edge-case
- rare: if an employee accepts a promo and then an external offer/other change triggers a rescind, People Ops will review case-by-case. managers: document timeline, approvals, and any communications. Compensation adjustments may be reversed only with documented approvals.

evan_total_rewards: 4) international currency conversions and comp bands
- bands are expressed in USD internal reference. for payroll/payout we convert to local currency using the payroll provider's published rate on the pay date. small rounding differences can occur; Total Rewards will review material mismatches.

noa_peopleops: 5) who signs if manager leaves mid-process
- primary: skip-level signs. fallback: director or People Ops signs to prevent delays. always include a short note in the packet describing the sign-off chain.

noa_peopleops: tiny manager checklist (paste into packet subject/body)
- Name, current & proposed title + band
- Effective date (YYYY-MM-DD) and "RETRO? yes/no"
- 2 bullets: why (impact) and 1 supporting artifact link
- New comp (base + target bonus) and currency note if abroad
- Signer (skip-level/director) & contact email

noa_peopleops: short manager one-liner for 1:1s:
"Congrats <name> 12 we're promoting you to <new title> effective <date>. This reflects your recent impact on <metric/project>. We'll send paperwork and confirm payroll timing; let me know any Qs."

people-ops-bot: Promo packet template (compact) uploaded: https://drive.google.com/example-compact-packet (auto message)

noa_peopleops: i'll post a one-pager in #managers with these bullets and the template link by tomorrow morning. booking a single 20-min office hour for packet walk-throughs; DM me if you need a private review.
sophia_ceo: great work 10 thanks for the quick clarity.
